heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy, rainwest of the Green Mountains tapering off early from southwest to northeast. Widespread areas of dense fog after dark. Lows in the 40s to low 50s. Winds north to northeast up to 10 mph, becoming light and variable.

heading: Tuesday
text: Morning clouds and areas of fog, with a spotty shower in NH until mid-morning. Cloudy, giving way to increasing breaks of sun by the evening, especially in the St. Lawrence and northern Adirondacks. Cool. Highs in the low to mid 60s. Winds light, mainly north less than 10 mph.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: Clouds decreasing from the west becoming clear, fog developing in the valleys around midnight. Lows in the mid 40s to low 50s. Winds light and variable.
